name: Vasu Goyal
qualification: Prepare effectively for MRCS
specialties: NHS job applications and CV reviews
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Vasu Goyal — currently working as a Trust Grade FY2 Doctor in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Airedale NHS Foundation Trust in North Yorkshire. I’m a Gold Medalist from GITAM Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, where I completed both my MBBS and internship. My long-term goal is to become a Cardiothoracic Surgeon, and I recently cleared the MRCS exam (January 2025) as part of that journey.
Over the past few years, I’ve gained hands-on experience across India and the UK, having served as a Resident Medical Officer at both Mittal Hospital and Apollo Hospital. I’ve also pursued additional training in emergency care, patient safety, PROMPT, and clinical audits — accumulating over 80 CPD points. I'm skilled in critical care procedures, hospital protocols, and efficient patient communication.
My academic path has been decorated with medals, distinctions, and honors — including the University Best Student Award, which I was humbled to receive from both President Shri Pranab Mukherjee and Nobel Laureate Sir Michael Young. I’ve co-authored published research, presented at international conferences (including BAPIO), and am passionate about contributing to both clinical practice and academic advancement.
As a mentor, I aim to help students and junior doctors:
Navigate NHS pathways (FY1/FY2)
Prepare effectively for MRCS
Improve clinical confidence in patient care
Understand research, audits, and QIPs
Strategically choose the right specialty or role
I strongly believe that clarity, structured guidance, and the right mentorship can make all the difference.
If you're looking for someone who understands the IMG journey, exam pressure, and the value of mentorship — I’d be glad to support your next step.

name: Athresh Narayanamurthy
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Athresh Narayanamurthy — an Internal Medicine Trainee (IMT2) currently working at Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust , based in West Yorkshire, England, since April 2022.
I began my NHS journey as a Trust Grade Doctor and successfully secured a place in Internal Medicine Training (IMT) on my very first attempt. I’m currently in 2nd Year of IMT, and over the past few years, I’ve had the opportunity to mentor several IMGs and Trust Grade applicants through mock interviews, CREST form walkthroughs, portfolio development, and preparation for clinical and ethical scenario-based questions.
I completed my MBBS from J.J.M. Medical College (2013–2019), and my own transition into the NHS system has made me passionate about guiding others through the same path with clarity and confidence.
As your mentor, I can help you:
Understand and apply for Internal Medicine Training (IMT)
Ace NHS job interviews through focused prep and mock sessions
Build a high-impact CV tailored for NHS roles
Create a strong, structured portfolio aligned with UK training pathways
Balance clinical life in the NHS with personal growth and wellbeing
If you’re an IMG aspiring to join the NHS or step into Internal Medicine, I’d be happy to guide you through every step — from application to integration.
Let’s build your future in the NHS with structure, confidence, and purpose.

name: Syed Irfan
bio:
Dr. Syed Irfan
Mentor | PLAB & UK Clinical Guidance Specialist
I am Dr. Syed Irfan, a mentor with experience guiding doctors through the PLAB exams and transitioning into the UK healthcare system. I provide practical advice on clinical assessments, FY1 experiences, and navigating general NHS work life.
My focus is on helping mentees gain confidence, build essential clinical skills, and make informed decisions as they start their medical careers in the UK.

name: Sameena Tabassum
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Sameena Tabassum — a Resident Doctor at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), a passionate USMLE mentor, and someone deeply committed to guiding fellow IMGs on their journey to the United States.
I’ve successfully completed USMLE Step 1 and Step 2, and have been actively mentoring aspirants — especially those reapplying for USA visas or navigating the step exams — by offering practical advice, structured guidance, and emotional support. I know what it feels like to walk this path, and I’m here to help make it smoother for others.
My love for Pediatrics and Medicine, Content writing, and Public health education has led me to create engaging study aids, mnemonics, and simplified learning tools for my peers — from organic chemistry to developmental milestones. I’ve also had the opportunity to work on high-impact global programs such as the LedBy Corporate Leaders Fellowship, Aspire Harvard Leaders Program, and IPHMDP Case Study Team at PGIMER Chandigarh, having completed my clinical rotations at Harvard Medical School, Mayo Clinic, USA.
As your mentor, I can help you with:
Strategic preparation for USMLE Step 1 & 2
Guidance on securing FREE clinical rotations in the U.S.
Support for USA visa applications, especially Re applicants
Creating resumes/CV , personal statement advice, and storytelling for residency applications
Balancing your medical goals with well-being and purpose
Whether you’re just starting your USMLE prep or feeling stuck in the process, I’m here to walk with you — with empathy, structure, and clarity.
Let’s turn confusion into confidence, and dreams into action. 🌟

name: Vishal Kalmani
qualification: Hi, I’m Dr. Vishal Kalmani, an MBBS graduate and GMC-registered doctor, currently pursuing a career as a junior doctor in the UK.
specialties: Postgraduate specialization pathways in the UK
bio:
Hi, I’m Dr. Vishal Kalmani, an MBBS graduate and GMC-registered doctor, currently pursuing a career as a junior doctor in the UK.
Having firsthand experience navigating the PLAB pathway and the NHS system, I understand the challenges international medical graduates (IMGs) face while transitioning into their medical careers abroad.
I’m passionate about guiding IMGs through every step of their journey, from exam preparation to career progression. Whether it’s understanding the PLAB process, adapting to the NHS work environment, or making informed career choices, I strive to provide the right guidance to help doctors achieve their goals in the UK.
I am also certified in Advanced Life Support (ALS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS), equipping me with essential skills to handle critical care situations. Alongside my clinical work, I am committed to mentorship and medical education, collaborating with initiatives like GooCampus to support and guide medical students and doctors in their professional journey.
I believe in continuous learning, collaboration, and giving back to the medical community.
If you’re an aspiring doctor, an IMG, or looking for guidance on your career path, feel free to connect!
Always happy to share, learn, and grow together.

name: Abhishek Ray
specialties: Postgraduate specialization pathways in the UK
bio:
I am a gastroenterology and general internal medicine trainee in the NHS (UK ), with extensive clinical experience across both the UK and India. Having navigated the unique challenges and opportunities within both healthcare systems, I am well-equipped to support individuals transitioning between them, offering tailored advice and practical insights.
Alongside my medical training, I am certified in Human Factors, enabling me to mentor effectively across a wide range of professional grades and backgrounds. Over the past eight years, I have had the privilege of mentoring both medical students and doctors, consistently receiving positive feedback for my supportive and personalised approach.
Whether you are at the start of your journey or looking to take the next big step in your career, I am passionate about helping you navigate the path ahead and achieve your goals. I look forward to working with you and supporting you in reaching your full potential.

name: Madhurika Jalakam
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Madhurika Jalakam — a Junior Doctor working at East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust in the UK, and an aspiring Anaesthetics trainee. I completed my MBBS from MNR Medical College and moved to the UK after successfully clearing PLAB and registering with the GMC.
Having transitioned from the Indian medical curriculum into the NHS system, I understand how overwhelming and confusing this journey can be for IMGs. That’s why I’m passionate about mentoring others — to help simplify the process and provide clarity where it’s most needed.
As your mentor, I can support you in:
Understanding how the NHS works and what to expect
Preparing effectively for PLAB 1 and PLAB 2
Completing your GMC registration step-by-step
Strengthening your communication skills for clinical practice
Bridging the gap between Indian training and UK medical practice
If you're preparing for your UK journey and want real insights from someone who’s been there — I’m here to guide you.
Let’s take the next step in your NHS journey, together.

name: Sankar Ram
bio:
Dr. Sankar Ram
Mentor | PLAB & NHS Career Specialist
I am Dr. Sankar Ram, a mentor with experience guiding doctors through the PLAB exams and working successfully in the UK healthcare system. I specialize in helping mentees understand career progression within the NHS, navigate challenges as international medical graduates, and make informed decisions about their professional journey.
My goal is to provide practical, structured guidance that empowers aspiring doctors to achieve their goals confidently while building a successful career in the UK.

name: Pradeep Sabapathy
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Pradeep Sabapathy — currently working as a Junior Clinical Fellow in HPB Surgery at King’s College Hospital, London. My journey in medicine has taken me across the Philippines, India, and the UK, giving me a global perspective on healthcare, surgical training, and patient care.
I completed my Doctor of Medicine (MBBS) from the University of Perpetual Help System DALTA in Manila, followed by a medical internship at St. John’s Medical College Hospital in Bengaluru, where I received hands-on experience in triage, critical care, pediatrics, and surgery. I’ve also worked as a Resident Doctor at Sparsh Hospital, Bengaluru, and have actively volunteered with Aarogya Seva, an international humanitarian healthcare NGO.
My interest lies in surgery, clinical innovation, and education. I’ve contributed to organizing MIT Hacking Medicine’s Tech4Health conference and have conducted PLAB-1 teaching sessions and motivational talks for exam candidates — helping others navigate their journey into the NHS and clinical training pathways.
As your mentor, I can help you with:
NHS clinical adaptation and hospital workflows
PLAB preparation tips and structured guidance
Surgical skills insights and early career prep in surgery
Building your clinical portfolio and research exposure
Balancing a medical career with personal development and leadership
Outside the hospital, I’m passionate about MMA, table tennis, and badminton, and I believe every doctor needs a creative outlet and inner discipline beyond clinical life. Whether you're preparing for PLAB, exploring surgical careers, or just seeking honest mentorship from someone who's walked the path — I’m here to support you.
Let’s work together to shape your next step with confidence and clarity.

name: Zeeshan Mohammad
bio:
I am an Internal Medicine Training (IMT) trainee at Brighton and Sussex University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, with 2.5 years of NHS experience in Renal Medicine, Acute and General Medicine at King’s College Hospital.
As an international medical graduate myself, I understand the challenges of transitioning into the NHS - from adapting to a new healthcare system to building confidence in clinical practice. Having been through that journey, I’m passionate about supporting and guiding others through it.
I’ve passed MRCP Part 1 and Part 2, presented posters at national conferences, led successful quality improvement projects, and tailored my teaching and tutoring sessions to support others in strengthening their portfolios. I’m keen to share practical strategies on building a strong application for IMT and beyond, helping IMGs feel confident, prepared, and supported throughout their journey.

name: Mohammed Hyzoom
qualification: MBBS | Fellowship in Diabetes Mellitus (Medvarsity & Royal Liverpool Academy)
bio:
MBBS | Fellowship in Diabetes Mellitus (Medvarsity & Royal Liverpool Academy)
Junior Doctor | Diabetology Enthusiast | Mentor & Medical Educator
Hi, I’m Dr. Mohammed Hyzoom, a dedicated and passionate medical professional with over 3 years of clinical experience. After completing my MBBS from MES Medical College, I pursued a Fellowship in Diabetes Mellitus from Medvarsity in collaboration with the Royal Liverpool Academy. This journey has deepened my commitment to providing compassionate, evidence-based care—especially in the field of Diabetology.
My current work at City Polyclinic and Diabetic Centre has exposed me to a wide range of patient care experiences, from managing chronic diabetes to offering preventive and lifestyle-based health guidance. Alongside clinical practice, I find great purpose in mentoring and educating the next generation of doctors.
Over the years, I’ve discovered a strong interest in teaching, guiding, and supporting medical students and early-career professionals. Whether it's helping someone build their confidence, polish their CV, or prepare for competitive interviews, I’m here to share what I’ve learned and make their journey a little easier.
I can help you with:
Building self-confidence as a medical student or young doctor
CV building and portfolio guidance for med school or job applications
Interview prep for medical colleges and fellowship programs
Understanding anatomy with practical techniques
Exploring the role of virtual reality in modern medical education
Insights into diabetic care and patient-centered counseling
I believe mentorship is not just about answering questions—it's about walking the path with you, offering clarity when things feel uncertain, and helping you realize your potential with confidence and direction. If you're looking for someone who understands the journey and genuinely wants to see you grow, I’m here for you.
Let’s connect and move forward—together.

name: Santhosh Manikandan
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Santhosh Manikandan — a passionate Geriatric and Palliative Care Physician, currently leading the Department of Geriatric Medicine, Palliative Care, and Home Care at GKNM Hospital, Coimbatore.
I hold an MD in Geriatric Medicine from Madras Medical College, where I was honored with the University Gold Medal. I’ve also completed a Fellowship in Palliative Medicine from the Institute of Palliative Medicine, Kozhikode. My clinical journey is driven by a deep commitment to elderly care, especially in diagnosing and managing complex conditions in the aging population.
Beyond the hospital setting, I strongly believe in the future of home-based care and am actively working to revolutionize home healthcare services to improve the quality of life for seniors in India.
As a mentor, I’d love to support you with:
Clinical strategies in geriatrics and palliative care
Home care models and end-of-life decision-making
Academic and research guidance (frailty, cognition, Vitamin D, etc.)
Career planning in niche specialties and community health
Combining clinical excellence with empathy in real-world practice
If you’re someone who wants to make a real difference in elder care — not just treat, but truly care — let’s connect.

name: Apoorv Tiwari
qualification: MBBS | MD | INTERNAL MEDICINE | MRCP UK | DHA | ENDOCRINOLOGIST USA
specialties: Postgraduate specialization pathways in the UK
bio:
MBBS | MD | INTERNAL MEDICINE | MRCP UK | DHA | ENDOCRINOLOGIST USA
With extensive experience in mentoring aspiring medical professionals across the US, UK, and India, I have successfully guided and tutored over 100 students on international platforms for prestigious examinations such as the USMLE, MRCP UK, and NEET-PG India.
My commitment extends to providing comprehensive training for residency interviews, and helping candidates secure coveted spots in the US healthcare system.
Currently, I serve as an Internal Medicine Resident at Garden City Hospital in Michigan, where I also engage in various leadership roles, including Chair of the Academic Council and committee member on the Code Blue/Rapid Response Team and Quality Improvement Committee. Recognized for my contributions, I received the Early Career Forum Award at ENDO Boston 2024 and actively participated as a peer reviewer for the American College of Gastroenterology Case Reports Journal.
Additionally, I have presented as primary author with more than 12 posters at state and national meetings and conferences across the US and published articles in various PubMed-indexed journals.
My dedication to education and quality care drives my passion for mentoring the next generation of healthcare professionals. I empower aspiring medical professionals through strategic exam preparation, personalized mentorship, and guided pathways to global residency programs.
Expert Mentor for Competitive Exams and Residency Applications
As a seasoned mentor, I offer personalized guidance to aspiring medical professionals seeking to excel in competitive exams and residency applications. My expertise spans:
Exam Preparation
- MRCP (UK)
- DHA
- NEET PG
- USMLE
Career Development
- CV building and optimization
- Research skills enhancement
- Interview skills coaching
- Residency portfolio development for US Internal Medicine (IM) programs
Career Pathway Guidance
- US and UK career pathways: timeline, application process, and requirements
- Comparison of US, UK, and Indian career pathways
- Strategic advice on applying to IM programs in the US to maximize chances of selection while minimizing costs
Whether you're a medical student or a practicing physician, I can help you navigate the complex landscape of competitive exams and residency applications. Let's work together to achieve your career goals.
# Let's Connect!
Feel free to reach out to me for mentorship, guidance, or simply to discuss your career aspirations.
certifications: Membership of Royal College of Physicians

name: Karan Gupta
bio:
I am Dr. Karan Gupta, a committed physician with a strong foundation in clinical practice, medical education, and community advocacy. I earned my MBBS from Government Medical College, Patiala, and went on to complete my Master of Surgery (MS) in Orthopedic Surgery from the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh.
My clinical journey has taken me across various healthcare settings in Canada, including roles as an Associate Physician with Island Health in British Columbia, a Clinical Surgical Assistant at Alberta Health Services, and a Clinical Physician Assistant in Ontario. I've also contributed to medical research and documentation as a Medical Writer at Pharma Medica Research Inc. and as a Clinical Research Assistant with the World Headache Society.
Beyond clinical work, I am deeply invested in guiding international medical graduates and aspiring physicians through critical transitions in their careers.
My mentorship areas include:
MCCQE exam preparation
Step-by-step USMLE guidance (U.S. pathway)
CV building for medical aspirants
CaRMS residency match strategy
Preparation for Canadian and U.S. residency programs
With active involvement in global healthcare communities, I am passionate about bridging clinical care with education and advocacy to support the next generation of healthcare professionals.
Let's Connect!

name: Nayanaa Varsaale
bio: As a mentor, I provide guidance and support to aspiring medical professionals, particularly in psychiatry. With my experience in clinical practice, research, and teaching, I offer insights into career progression, exam preparation (such as MSRA and MRCPsych), and clinical skills development. I also assist with research involvement, academic writing, and navigating the NHS system. My approach is tailored, ensuring mentees gain confidence, knowledge, and practical strategies to succeed in their medical journey.

name: Rupali Sachdev
specialties: Part-time job options for medical students
bio:
📍Founder of CHILL academy
📚 Clinical Teaching Fellow at University Hospitals Sussex
🔬 Ex-Research Scientist at ICMR
📹 Healthcare Content Creator
I am a UK-based clinician and educator with a passion for academic medicine, research, and digital innovation in medical education. My career spans clinical, academic, and content-driven domains, unified by a mission to empower medical professionals through mentorship, education, and opportunity creation.
My foundation training was completed at Royal Liverpool University Hospital (LUHFT), where I developed robust experience in acute and emergency care. Prior to moving to the UK, I served as a Research Scientist with the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), contributing to evidence-based initiatives at a national level and gaining a deep understanding of research methodology and translational science.
In parallel, I am the Founder of CHILL Academy, a platform aimed at helping early-career medics find clarity, mentorship, and growth in their career journeys. As a healthcare content creator, I leverage social media to deliver practical insights on clinical careers, NHS training pathways (including MSRA and ACCS EM), digital networking, and entrepreneurship in medicine.
Helping medics find opportunities for growth 🩺

name: Ritika Tuli
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Ritika Tuli — a PGY-4 Cardiology Fellow at Allegheny General Hospital in Pittsburgh, and currently an Editorial Fellow with the American College of Cardiology (ACC 2024–2025 cohort).
I’m a first-generation international medical graduate from Kasturba Medical College, Manipal, and have lived, trained, and practiced across India, China, and the United States. These diverse experiences have not only shaped my medical understanding but also deepened my commitment to inclusive, accessible healthcare education.
My core clinical interests lie in cardiovascular imaging, cardio-oncology, and healthcare systems leadership. I’ve completed my Internal Medicine Residency at MedStar Washington Hospital Center, with an additional rotation in Sleep Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania, where I explored complex sleep-related cardiovascular interactions.
I’m also a strong believer in democratizing medical knowledge. That’s why I created #CardioNuggets—a social media initiative that shares daily, high-yield cardiology pearls with over 50,000 learners globally on X (formerly Twitter). My work in medical education has been featured through publications in BMJ Open and the Journal of Intensive Care Medicine.
As your mentor, I can help you with:
Strategic planning for US residency and cardiology fellowships
Building your research profile and preparing for publications
Developing strong medical communication skills
Career transitions across clinical and non-clinical domains
Thriving as a first-gen IMG navigating global health systems
If you’re a student, resident, or IMG exploring cardiology, research, or academic medicine — I’d love to share what I’ve learned and help you chart a path with clarity and confidence.

name: Meenakshi Phanse
specialties: Postgraduate specialization pathways in the UK
bio:
Dr. Meenakshi Phanse
Mentor | UK Postgraduate Pathways & Clinical Skills Specialist
I am Dr. Meenakshi Phanse, a mentor with experience guiding doctors through the UK medical system, including postgraduate specialization pathways. I focus on building strong clinical foundations, including patient history-taking, portfolio development, and effective communication in English for medical professionals.
My goal is to help mentees navigate the NHS system confidently, enhance their professional profiles, and make informed decisions about their career progression in the UK. I am committed to providing practical, personalized guidance that empowers aspiring doctors to succeed in their international medical careers.

name: Pallavi Rajhans
bio:
I am a passionate and dedicated psychiatrist with a strong foundation in both clinical practice and research. I completed my MD in Psychiatry from the esteemed All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, where I had the privilege of training and working with some of the best professionals in the field. From 2019 to 2022, I served as a Senior Resident at AIIMS and the National Drug Dependence Treatment Centre (NDDTC), where I gained invaluable experience in the treatment of drug and substance use disorders.
Throughout my career, I have had the opportunity to work in various settings, including serving as a Consultant Psychiatrist at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi, and currently at Sama Hospital, Delhi. I’m also actively involved with organizations like Tamana and the Aga Khan Foundation, where I contribute to mental health initiatives.
As a mentor, I aim to share my knowledge, experiences, and insights with others in the field, while also fostering an environment of empathy, learning, and growth. I believe in guiding individuals to not only excel in their careers but also to develop a strong sense of compassion and understanding in their work with patients. I’m excited about the opportunity to mentor and support others as they navigate their professional journeys in psychiatry.
Feel free to tweak or add anything that reflects your voice even more!

name: Harish Kumar S
qualification: Hello, I’m Dr. Harish Kumar S — a passionate doctor with an MD in Pharmacology and over 10 years of experience across various facets of medicine.
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Harish Kumar S — a passionate doctor with an MD in Pharmacology and over 10 years of experience across various facets of medicine.
Currently, I serve as a Regional Medical Advisor at Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, where I specialize in Osteoporosis therapy and handle medical affairs for the South India region. My career journey has been anything but conventional — spanning roles in corporate hospitals, primary health centers, the IT sector, industrial occupational health, academic teaching, and now the pharmaceutical industry.
Each of these experiences has shaped my understanding of medicine far beyond textbooks — and I’m here to share that with the next generation of doctors. I truly believe that medicine offers multiple rewarding career paths, and I’m committed to helping young professionals find their own.
As a mentor, I can guide you in:
Choosing the right medical specialization
Transitioning into non-clinical roles in pharma or medical affairs
Developing strong public speaking and presentation skills
Understanding the day-to-day of corporate healthcare and industry roles
Navigating your career with confidence — from clinics to conferences
If you’re looking to discover new dimensions in medicine, I’d be happy to help you explore and excel.

name: Sana Khan
bio:
Hello, I’m Dr. Sana Khan — a Board-Certified Pediatrician and Pediatric Emergency Room Physician based in New York City.
My journey began in Nigeria, continued through India where I completed my MD in Pharmacology at AIIMS, and led me to the U.S. where I trained as a Pediatric Resident at SUNY Downstate. Today, I serve on the frontlines of pediatric care at Flushing Hospital, combining clinical precision with deep compassion — because I’ve lived the IMG experience from the ground up.
Alongside clinical work, I’ve been a researcher at Cleveland Clinic and NewYork-Presbyterian, and a bedside educator since my student days in UNIMAID. I’m a core empath, a proud FAAP member, and an unwavering advocate for foreign medical graduates — especially women in medicine and those from underserved backgrounds.
As your mentor, I’d be honored to help you with:
Navigating the USMLE & U.S. residency pathway (especially in Pediatrics)
Building confidence in clinical communication and emergency care
Transitioning between global healthcare systems (IMG support)
Finding your voice as a woman in medicine
Staying anchored in purpose while aiming for high-performance careers
I infect people with Positivity!!! I will teach you that nothing in this world is impossible if you believe you can. Lets make your dream to US come true!!!! I was once in your shoes, if i can do it, so can you!!!!

name: Krishnapriya Balanarayanan
bio:
Hey, I’m KP Balan.
I studied Medicine at Manipal University, India and moved to Australia in 2017. Since 2019, I’ve been working here in the Aussie healthcare system. I passed both the AMC MCQ and the AMC Clinical (face-to-face) exams on my first try, with around 5–6 months of prep in between.
Right now, I’m in the Emergency Department training program. I also run KP Balan Pty Ltd and represent International Medical Graduates (IMGs) as a Council Member for the Australian Medical Association (AMA) in WA.
I know how overwhelming it can be—moving to a new country, figuring out the AMC process, and trying to break into the system. The pressure, the stress, and that urge to just start working—I’ve felt it all.
That’s why I’m here to help. My focus is on guiding you through the Australian medical pathway, helping you choose what’s right for you, and supporting you through exam prep, CV building, and interview skills—basically everything you need to stand out to recruiters and land that job.
And hopefully, we’ll get to work together in Australia one day!

name: Dhruv Chauhan
qualification: MBBS | National Spokesperson – IMA JDN | Medical Influencer | TEDx Speaker | International Chess Player | Martial Artist
bio:
Hello, I'm Dr. Dhruv Chauhan
MBBS | National Spokesperson – IMA JDN | Medical Influencer | TEDx Speaker | International Chess Player | Martial Artist
I'm a doctor by qualification, but a communicator and changemaker at heart. I currently serve as the National Spokesperson for the Indian Medical Association – Junior Doctors Network, where I work towards amplifying the voice of young doctors across the country.
I’ve always believed that medicine isn’t just about clinics and hospitals — it’s about leadership, impact, and reaching people where they are. Over the years, I’ve grown into one of India’s most followed medical content creators on Twitter, and I’ve used this platform to make medical knowledge more accessible, relatable, and empowering — especially for students and early-career doctors.
Outside of medicine, I’m an internationally rated chess player and a martial artist, both of which have shaped my discipline, strategy, and mindset — qualities I bring into my mentorship and professional life. I’ve also had the honour of delivering two TEDx talks, most recently at AIIMS Raipur, where I spoke about redefining success and failure in medicine.
In 2024, I was humbled to receive my 10th national-level award, the Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Samman, awarded by the National Medical Commission and Ministry of Health — a moment that reaffirmed my commitment to youth leadership in healthcare.
Mentorship Skills:
NEET coaching and preparation strategies (India)
Effective use of medical apps and digital tools in clinical practice
Public speaking and presentation skills tailored for doctors
Digital branding and marketing for medical professionals
Communication and interpersonal skills in healthcare settings
Let’s connect and take your journey forward — beyond the textbook and into the real world of modern medicine.

name: Naren Karthik Sakthi Saravanan
qualification: Junior Resident | MBBS (Coimbatore Medical College Hospital) | BMJ-Certified in Health & Clinical Research
bio:
Junior Resident | MBBS (Coimbatore Medical College Hospital) | BMJ-Certified in Health & Clinical Research
I am a medical graduate from Coimbatore Medical College, affiliated with The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, and currently working as a Junior Resident. Throughout my academic and clinical journey, I have been deeply interested in the intersection of clinical medicine and research, with a particular focus on health, clinical, and public health research.
I have completed the BMJ Research to Publication certification, a program jointly developed by the BMJ and the University of California, San Francisco, which has equipped me with strong foundations in evidence-based medicine, research methodology, and scientific writing.
As a young doctor, I’m passionate about mentoring and guiding medical students who are navigating the early stages of their careers. I enjoy simplifying complex concepts and helping others develop strong research skills, particularly in areas like health research, clinical research, and public health.
I believe that medicine is as much about critical thinking and innovation as it is about compassion and care. Through ongoing learning, research participation, and mentoring, I aim to contribute meaningfully to both clinical practice and academic growth.

name: Karthik Ajith
specialties: Postgraduate specialization pathways in the UK
bio:
Having graduated from JIPMER, Pondicherry, I have a strong footing in clinical practice and research, with peer-reviewed publications and international oral presentations. With a strong interest in Clinical Neurology and Neuroscience research, I worked as a Research Fellow in Movement Disorders at Sree Chitra Institute for 6 months right after my Internship and as a Non-PG Resident in Neurology at CMC, Vellore.
I decided to pursue my postgraduate training in the UK and cleared both parts of PLAB. The following are my achievements to date in the UK training pathway.
- I secured 537 marks in MSRA 2025 (and got an offer for my first preference GP training post, although I did not take it).
- I qualified FY2 standalone SJT and ranked 66 in the interview in 2025, securing one of my top 3 preferred FY2 jobs.
I am open to guiding students in preparing for the MSRA, FY2 SJT, and FY2 standalone interview.

name: Aishwarya Wodeyar
qualification: Hi, I’m Dr. Wodeyar, and if you’re an MBBS student or a budding MD Pharmacologist wondering “What’s next for me? you’ve just found a thoughtful friend.
bio:
Hi, I’m Dr. Wodeyar, and if you’re an MBBS student or a budding MD Pharmacologist wondering “What’s next for me? you’ve just found a thoughtful friend.
